method: Resolve PROOF declarations by translation-unit static scope, then public scope. Follow lexical identifiers, get_ references and HOL constant -> _def references to a fixed point. Subtract complete slices of the 30 prior concrete units and six readiness units. Exclude top cmc.c (already measured), external framework code and getter/export scaffolding.
limitations: Includes quoted identifiers and unused local helpers if lexically referenced; this is not an execution trace of proof construction.
Generated datatype/interface declarations and generic HOL framework support are not a complete historical implementation cost.
No source-to-target dependency ratio is inferred from this conservative slice.
